name: Ray Marching Particle Grid Traversal
definition: A hybrid ray marching technique that traverses a voxel grid to find particle hits, using a low-resolution grid for culling and a high-resolution grid for precise hit testing.
summary: Ray Marching Particle Grid Traversal is a hybrid technique that uses a low-resolution occupancy grid to cull empty space, switching to high-resolution traversal only when particles are detected to efficiently locate hits in dense systems.
